text: Online exams break at the worst possible moment. The Wi-Fi drops. A tab switches. A result gets questioned. This is Inventix Invigil. Exams that hold up.

Here's what's under the hood. A Rust core on Axum and SQLx. PostgreSQL seventeen on Supabase, with row level security on every table. A Next.js sixteen and React nineteen front end. HTTP-only host cookies, CSRF checks, rate limits, Argon2 passwords, two-step sign-in and admin step-up. Results signed with Ed25519. Gemini for grading help. Five hundred and fifty automated tests, shipped on Vercel and Render.
This is the live site. One clear promise, the method, resilience, integrity and security, all on a single page, with a way for institutes to reach us.
Sign in is one screen. Accounts are created by the institution, so there's no open sign-up to abuse.
Examiners start in the question bank. Filter by topic, difficulty and type, preview any question, and see how it performed in past exams.
Creating an exam takes a minute. Title, instructions, the window, duration, marks, and the integrity rules, each in its own clear card.
Then build the paper. Pick questions from the bank, set marks, and watch the total. Turn on fair papers, and every candidate draws a different paper of equal difficulty.
Enrol candidates by email or CSV. Review and publish checks every rule, flags anything to fix, and freezes the paper only when it's ready.
Now, the candidate. The dashboard shows what's next, with a countdown driven by the server clock. The lobby explains exactly what is recorded, and nothing more.
Inside the exam, every answer saves within a second. Flag questions, use the scratchpad, jump around with the navigator.

Now pull the plug. The exam keeps going. Answers are sealed into a hash-chained journal on the device. The moment the network returns, everything syncs, and the server confirms it. The deadline lives on the server, so time can't be gamed.

Back in the control room, the examiner sees every candidate live. Progress, connection, integrity signals, and activity charts that move as the exam runs. Send an announcement, or credit a verified outage, in one click.
Grading is blind. Scripts show labels, not names. For written answers, the AI assistant suggests a mark against the rubric, with its reasoning. The examiner always has the final say.

Results publish with full analytics: score distribution, topic performance, and item analysis that spots questions that are too hard or misleading. Export a branded PDF report or a CSV, named properly.
Every result comes with a certificate code. Anyone can check it in seconds. The statement is signed, masked, and tamper evident.
Admins see the whole platform. Sign-ins, sessions and accounts in live charts, every action in the audit trail, and institute requests in one queue.
And it all works on a phone, in portrait and in landscape.
Resilient. Fair. Verifiable. Inventix Invigil. Exams that hold up.
